scope: Current allocation and payment availability; audit only

findings.title: Low-price services do not preserve strict 20/10/5/65 allocation
findings.impact: A larger prize output reduces the advertised Kingdom percentage at low service prices.
findings.recommendation: Choose a conforming price/output policy and align published percentages before accepting funds under that promise.

findings.title: Newest-first reconciliation can indefinitely delay older funded operations
findings.impact: New unpaid rows can prevent automatic observations and credit for older submitted or funded financial actions.
findings.recommendation: Implement fair bounded scheduling and funded-operation priority with per-account quote quotas and owner retries.

findings.title: Permanently rejected signed payouts retain reservations without recovery
findings.impact: A signed but never accepted payout can hold the full selected inputs unavailable indefinitely.
findings.recommendation: Add safe durable rejection/conflict/replacement recovery; never unlock potentially live signed inputs solely by timeout.
